2a21014f4f.q: What is the acceptable timeline for closing monthly books in IT services firms preparing for acquisition?
2a21014f4f.a: Timely management usually means within two weeks of the close of the month, which is generally accepted as a timely close. If it takes two months, there will be a lot of questions by buyers about the maturity of your financial systems and accounting governance. Even if it is multi-currency or multi-country, it should not be a markedly delayed process.

b5d768ef67.q: What key performance metrics should IT services firms track and share with teams beyond headline P&L numbers?
b5d768ef67.a: IT services companies should track utilization and realization as primary levers, with a target of 80% against a 2080-hour year for utilization. Beyond that, teams should understand recurring versus one-time revenue, how pricing and utilization impact gross margin per customer, and contractual arrangements that affect utilization. The business should also measure pipeline cleanliness every two weeks and review results against budgeted goals on a monthly basis with key team members.
